launch_condition: The frozen third 256-episode val-seen normalized-terminal-RLOO pilot completes with zero inference errors, exact coverage, independently recounted paired SR and SPL each at least +2.0 percentage points, and the independent GAE gate records skip_gae_for_scale.
method: normalized terminal-outcome turn-level leave-one-out PPO; no geodesic progress or semantic verifier reward
control: existing exact512 outcome-only GRPO checkpoints at seeds 11, 22, and 33, subject to source and evaluation reuse audit
evaluation: R2R val-unseen, 1839 paired episodes per seed, one decode per episode at the matching seed, four shards, identical evaluator and manifest to verified controls
limitations: The pilot val-seen split and larger val-unseen replication have been used during method development. Passing a one-seed pilot is only a resource-allocation rule, not robust evidence; full val-unseen is not a clean final test.
